title: NIT Silchar Notification 2026 - Apply for Various Project Associate Posts
description: The National Institute of Technology Silchar (NIT Silchar) has issued the official notification for the recruitment of Project Associate I positions. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech or M.E/ M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering can grab this chance and apply for the NIT Silchar Notification 2026 .
